description: This file defines functions to load test include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration for the IRC extension. It also exports a default configuration by invoking the creation function.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the IRC extension with specified environment and default patterns.
